services.title: Spring Replacement
services.description: Broken springs are dangerous. We replace both torsion and extension springs with heavy-duty upgrades.

services.title: Opener Repair & Install
services.description: Motor burned out? Chain broke? We fix all opener brands or install new units with smart features.

services.title: Track & Panel Repair
services.description: Bent tracks and dented panels don't have to mean full replacement. Most damage is fixable.

services.title: Emergency Service
services.description: Door stuck open or closed? We respond fast to get your garage secure again.

about.heading: Jacksonville garage door specialists
about.body: We're the team your neighbors call when their garage door quits. One truck, one tech, one honest price.

reviews.name: William R.
reviews.text: Highly recommend Cornerstone. Called for an opener replacement and got an appointment within hours. Damien arrived on time with a free estimate.

reviews.name: Mellisha G.
reviews.text: After quotes around $1,800 from others, they fixed my complex issue for just $500 and upgraded the spring. Professional and personable — 10/10 recommend.

reviews.name: Katie D.
reviews.text: Excellent experience! Affordable, punctual, and knowledgeable. Got an appointment within 24 hours and the tech explained everything clearly.

cta.heading: Door acting up? Let's fix it today
cta.body: Free estimates, upfront pricing, and same-day service when possible. No hidden fees, no runaround.
